name: forja
description: Code writing styles with a deterministic verifier: writing disciplines (clean, defensive, functional, solid) and the minimal-diff surgery protocol for editing existing code as AgenC output styles — plus a structural code linter that verifies every draft (function bands, nesting, naming, duplicates, consistency with the host file) before delivery. The model writes; the linter judges.

codigo.description: Write code with a chosen discipline, verified by a deterministic structural linter

interface.shortDescription: Code disciplines — and practical structural lint checks.
interface.longDescription: A code-writing-styles library and its verifier. Five disciplines ship as AgenC output styles: limpio (small single-purpose functions, early returns, intention-revealing names), defensivo (guard clauses at boundaries, fail-fast, no swallowed errors), funcional (pure functions, const discipline, transforms over mutation), solid (one responsibility per class, injected dependencies, composition over inheritance) — and minimal-diff, the surgery protocol for editing existing code: the smallest coherent change, matching the host file's own conventions. The differentiator is the deterministic structural verifier: every draft (JS/TS and Python, heuristics stated as heuristics) is checked for function-length bands, nesting depth, parameter counts, duplicate blocks, naming consistency, debug leftovers, dead imports, style-specific discipline — and, for edits, measurable consistency with the original file (indentation style and width, quote style, naming convention, semicolons). Violations carry concrete fixes; drafts must clear 85/100. Fully offline, zero dependencies, identical on local models.
